Reading and Writing Directions

The questions in this section address a number of important reading and writing skills. Each question includes one or more passages, which may include a table or graph. Read each passage and question carefully, and then choose the best answer to the question based on the passage(s).

Practice Mode Rules: Select an answer, then press Submit answer. Only submitted answers count toward your 3 attempts. Submitting the correct answer or reaching 3 incorrect submissions stops the timer and reveals detailed rationales inside every answer choice.
